interaction_definition: (book_guard-book_base)-(native_guard-native_base); each arm score is mean of its Red/Blue games in the same paired scenario

common_complete_case_interaction.method: Percentile paired bootstrap of common four-arm complete pair interactions; nearest outward order statistics

error_bound_interpretation: Finite-cohort identification bounds assigning each error score independently any value in [0,1]; not a confidence interval or missing-at-random assumption.
limits: Exploratory interaction, not confirmation or promotion. Primary within-study contrasts remain separately defined. No difference of mismatched-cohort means is used. Pair observations and outcomes are correlated across all four arms.
